The '''Garang spaceport cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located at the [[Garang spaceport]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. [[Rickard Lusoff]] and [[Calder Nettic]] once got drunk at the cantina and Rickard accused Calder of cheating him in a business deal. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tooka (Jedi)|Tooka]] was sent and resolved the conflict. [[Pazaak/Legends|Pazaak]] was a popular game at the cantina.
